figurative_meaning_en: to start a task or work
similar_in_english: to put one's hand to the plow
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাজ শুরু করার জন্য হাত দেওয়ার সময় হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I have put my hand to the project.
It's time to start the work by putting our hands to it.
note: Synonymous with 'হাত লাগানো', often used in contexts implying manual or practical initiation of tasks.
